lines.text: The Lord sends seventy-two ahead two by two, telling them to carry no purse, bag or sandals.
Jesus tells them to say 'Peace to this house' and to heal the sick in welcoming towns.
Jesus says it will be more bearable for Gomorrah than for an unwelcoming town, and Capernaum goes down to Hades.
The seventy-two return with joy, and Jesus says He gave them authority to tread on lions and scorpions.
Jesus praises the Father for revealing things to little children, and says many prophets and kings never saw this.
